item.title: 19k-Mile 1982 Volkswagen Vanagon L Westfalia Diesel 4-Speed
item.description: This 1982 Volkswagen Vanagon Westfalia L was initially sold through Continental Cars in Fort Wayne, Indiana, and is said to have remained in the state with two owners until the seller's acquisition in 2025. Finished in Ivory over brown vinyl and patterned cloth, the van is powered by a liquid-cooled 1.6L diesel inline-four mated to a four-speed manual transaxle. item.title: 2015 Land Rover LR4 HSE at No Reserve
item.description: This 2015 Land Rover LR4 HSE is finished in Corris Gray Metallic over Ebony leather and powered by a supercharged 3.0-liter V6 linked to an eight-speed automatic transmission. Equipment includes xenon headlights, dual sunroofs, 19" Style 702 alloy wheels, an electronic air suspension, heated power-adjustable front seats, third-row seating, dual-zone automatic climate control, cruise control, and a Meridian sound system. The truck was purchased by the current owner from the original owner in 2017

item.title: 10-Mile 2018 Dodge Challenger SRT Demon
item.description: This 2018 Dodge Challenger SRT Demon is #1,192 of approximately 3,300 examples built for the model year, and it has 10 miles. The car is powered by a supercharged 6.2-liter Hemi V8 linked to an eight-speed automatic transmission and a limited-slip differential and is finished in Pitch Black over black Laguna leather and Alcantara. item.title: 1984 Toyota Celica GT 5-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 1984 Toyota Celica GT liftback remained under the care of its original owner in California until 2025. It is finished in Blue Metallic over blue cloth upholstery and is powered by a 2.4-liter 22R-E inline-four paired with a five-speed manual transmission. Equipment includes 14" steel wheels, pop-up headlights, front bucket seats, rear-window louvers, power steering, cruise control, a stereo, and air conditioning. item.title: 36k-Mile 1994 Porsche 911 Turbo 3.6 at No Reserve
item.description: This 1994 Porsche 911 is one of a reported 754 Turbo 3.6 examples produced for the model year, and it left the factory finished in Black over a black interior with heated sport seats. item.description: This 1960 Porsche 356B coupe was acquired by the current owner in 1985, and it is powered by a 1.6-liter flat-four paired with a four-speed manual transaxle. The car is finished in Silver Metallic over blue leatherette, and equipment includes 15" steel wheels, a driver-side mirror, vent windows, body-color bumpers with chrome overriders and rub strips, an AM/FM radio, and front bucket seats. item.description: This 1969 DeTomaso Mangusta is one of approximately 401 examples built during four years of production, and it is powered by a 302ci Ford V8 linked to a ZF five-speed manual transaxle. The car has been repainted in red and features fixed quad headlights, Sebring-style side mirrors, 15” Campagnolo wheels, an independent coilover suspension, and four-wheel disc brakes. item.title: 13k-Mile 1987 Porsche 911 Turbo Coupe
item.description: This 1987 Porsche 911 Turbo coupe was specified in Guards Red over a Champagne Special leather interior with black accents, and it was optioned with a limited-slip differential.
